describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal hybrid shown in right-facing profile with the overall size, shape, fur, head and limbs of a brown bear but with glossy beetle-like structures integrated into its body. It is covered in thick, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and back and lighter tan on the muzzle, cheeks and underside. A single large, curved, glossy dark reddish-black horn rises from the top of the head, two large smooth domed shell plates sit on the back over the shoulders and mid-back, smaller segmented glossy plates cover the outer front legs, and a row of small round holes is visible in the fur on the side below the larger shell. It stands on four bear paws with visible claws and has a very short stubby tail.

describe.description: The creature is a large quadruped with the overall shape, thick shaggy brown fur, head, legs, paws and proportions of a brown bear, shown in side view walking to the right. Merged into its furry body are glossy dark reddish-brown beetle features: a single long curved horn on the forehead, two large hard shell plates on the back, segmented chitinous armor on the front legs, and a row of small round holes along the side of the torso.
